purpose: Predeclared procedural plus externally authored geometry test; no evaluation inputs used to fit the parser
target_volume_reference: Dense independent numerical integration: 801 stations x 1025 elevations
external_source: mathLab DTMB5415 IGES, commit afad0f04a2ce5ee03f37dcefbe697a5281bc0168, MIT
external_inference: generated raster sections from external CAD; not an independently authored scanned drawing
data_boundary: Inference subprocess gets spec/image only; evaluation reads physically separate labels after reconstruction
reporting: All attempted cases, exceptions, abstentions, timing, errors and baseline outputs must remain in the report. No gate adjustment after scoring.

confirmation_scope.reason: Initial v1 failures exposed a light drafting-grid contrast issue; root will independently correct parser on separate fixtures. This new suite is declared before confirmation scoring.
confirmation_scope.fresh_geometry: Twenty new procedural random seeds, same two families and same original rendering distributions/gates. These test within-generator generalization, not a new real drawing distribution.
confirmation_scope.reused_external: DTMB geometry and historical archive are reused; these are regression repeats, not newly unseen external geometry. The external degraded raster receives a newly predeclared noise seed.
confirmation_scope.prior_runs: Original v1 immutable inputs and all outcomes remain preserved. No v1 successes/failures are erased or replaced.
